Cyan: current run. Orange: previous compatible control (same physical fixture, source and observation schedule). Sampled speeds do not certify decay or equilibrium.

What this experiment establishes

A stationary support performs zero work. Initial elastic and gravitational energy are retained; contact work is signed, and viscous loss is counted once. Continued motion here can occur without rider or suspension feedback. It does not by itself justify extra damping or prove long-term instability.
